title: Kingfisher Group Camp
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: This group tent area will accommodate up to 100 people but there is no minimum required to occupy the site. Base rate includes the first 25 people, $5.00 per person thereafter. Base rate includes the first 5 vehicles. Any additional vehicles up to a maximum of 30 vehicles will be charged the nightly $10 extra vehicle fee. Only 1 recreational vehicle allowed. No hookups are available.
